svg.metadata: World map generated from Natural Earth Admin 0 country data, 1:110m, public domain. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson. Projection: equirectangular, lon0 0, lat0 0, scaleX 4, scaleY -4, translateX 720, translateY 360. This map keeps real longitude/latitude coordinates intact so future locations can be projected directly.
